clue.text: Quip about some duplicated key

parts.note: re is the Latin-derived word for concerning
part means a portion or some of something

indicators.note: duplicated says the note that follows is written twice over

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A witty retort concerning a musical key that keeps repeating.
explanation.definitionFit: Repartee is quick witty conversation, a string of clever retorts.

clue.text: Tear around say, being temporarily in charge

indicators.note: around means the word for tear is wrapped about the other piece

parts.note: a rent is a tear or rip
eg (for example) is signalled by say

explanation.surface: Someone tearing around while briefly left in charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A regent rules in place of a monarch who is absent or under age, holding power for a time.

clue.text: Pop round, cutting things fine

parts.note: pa and pop are both words for father
a ring is something round, a circle

explanation.surface: Dad going round shaving everything as thin as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: Paring is trimming away thin slices or reducing to the bare minimum.

clue.text: Battle on and turn "green" with time

indicators.note: turn tells us the letters of the quoted word are rearranged

parts.note: an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Soldiers fighting on, turning environmentally friendly over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' rearranges GREEN into REENG, and AGE is added after it.
explanation.definitionFit: To re-engage is to join battle again and continue fighting.

clue.text: Royalty in this country

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen
taken as written

explanation.surface: The monarchy as an institution within the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the standard crossword abbreviation for the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Erin is the old poetic name for Ireland.

clue.text: Give instruction to a company that's all at sea

definitions.text: a company that's all at sea
definitions.meaning: a group of fish swimming together, literally at sea

explanation.surface: Teaching a muddled business that has lost its way.
explanation.definitionFit: To school is to train; a school is also a shoal of fish in the ocean.

clue.text: Singer making a call about a couple of articles

indicators.note: about means the word for call goes round the other piece

parts.note: a cry is a call or shout
an and a are two indefinite articles

explanation.surface: A vocalist making a phone call about some newspaper pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articles' looks like newspaper items, but here it is the grammatical articles AN and A.
explanation.definitionFit: The canary is a songbird famous for its singing.

clue.text: Works gaining nothing by a set-up

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
per means by, as in per hour

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word above is read bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A factory that runs while getting nothing from a staged arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reads SET upwards as TES, giving O + PER + A + TES.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate is to function or run, as a machine works.

clue.text: A little dangerous, so they say

definitions.text: A little dangerous, so they say

parts.words: A little dangerous, so they say
parts.note: a reference to the proverb that a little knowledge of this kind is a dangerous thing

explanation.definitionFit: Pope wrote that a little of this, meaning knowledge acquired by study, is a dangerous thing.

clue.text: Taking a reading is such a bloomer!

indicators.note: taking is used here in the sense of seizing and reshaping the words that follow into a new order

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a reading was a big mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder, but it is a flowering plant; the letters of A READING are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The gardenia is a shrub prized for its fragrant white flowers.

clue.text: She shows endless irritation with the French

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the word for irritation is cut off

parts.note: anger is strong irritation
la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A woman showing irritation that never stops, alongside the French.
explanation.definitionFit: Angela is a woman's name, so she is an example of a female person.

clue.text: Retributive justice seems in order

indicators.note: order means the letters of the preceding words are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A comment that vengeful justice appears appropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis, named for the Greek goddess of vengeance, is punishment that is deserved and inevitable.

clue.text: Everybody remains behind? Not oneself?

definitions.meaning: if everybody stays put then nobody leaves, read as two words
in philosophy, everything outside the conscious self

explanation.surface: Wondering whether everyone stayed back and felt out of sorts.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it says nobody departs; as one term it is philosophy's name for the external world.

clue.text: Fruit and vegetable might appear about right

indicators.note: about places the first pieces around the abbreviation for right

parts.note: a pea is a vegetable
main means strength, as in might and main

explanation.surface: Produce that could turn up near the right side.
explanation.walkthrough: MAIN is might as in 'with might and main'; 'about' puts PEA MAIN around R.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearmain is a variety of apple.

clue.text: The skipper — a despicable man

definitions.meaning: one who leaps or jumps along
an old-fashioned word for a cad

explanation.surface: Describing a ship's captain as a contemptible fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who bounds skips along; the word is also dated slang for a cad.

clue.text: No ridge can be overlooked

indicators.note: can be suggests the letters of the preceding words may be made into something else

explanation.surface: A remark that a mountain ridge cannot be missed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be ignored is to be disregarded or not noticed.

clue.text: Slight incline

explanation.definitionFit: Lean means both thin of build and to tilt to one side.

clue.text: Go easy on the jam!

definitions.meaning: to use sparingly and avoid waste

explanation.surface: A warning not to spread the jam too thickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To conserve is to save or protect from waste; a conserve is also a preserve of fruit.

clue.text: Lack of generosity can land a girl in trouble

indicators.note: in places the girl inside the word for trouble

parts.note: a mess is trouble or difficulty
Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Stinginess that might get a young woman into difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Meanness is stinginess, an unwillingness to give or spend.

clue.text: The chase involved animals

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters of the preceding words are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A hunt that involved wild animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheetahs are big cats, the fastest land animals.

clue.text: Finished in a superior position

explanation.definitionFit: Over means both ended and situated above.

clue.text: Visible percipience

definitions.meaning: able to be seen, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: As two words it means visible; as one it means deep understanding.

clue.text: Face a group without parking

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the word for group goes around the parking letter

parts.note: a sect is a religious group
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: Confronting a group with nowhere to park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it is the old sense 'outside', so SECT surrounds P.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a side or face, as of a building facing a direction.

clue.text: Sarcastic humour at getting taken in by father

indicators.note: getting taken in by means the first word is placed inside the word for father

parts.note: a sire is a father

explanation.surface: Biting wit that took in a father.
explanation.definitionFit: Satire is mockery using irony and ridicule.

clue.text: Barker's cosy accommodation

parts.note: barker suggests a fairground tout, but it is a dog and this is its shelter

explanation.definitionFit: A dog's house or shelter, the barker being a dog.

clue.text: Left at home to occupy a relative

indicators.note: to occupy means the piece for at home is set inside the relative

parts.note: a sister is a family relative
in means at home

explanation.surface: Departing a house to move in with a family member.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinister is the heraldic and Latin word for the left-hand side.

clue.text: Watch out for a worker encompassing conflict

indicators.note: encompassing means the worker surrounds the conflict

parts.note: a worker bee is the classic crossword worker
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: Advice to be wary of an employee who brings fighting with them.
explanation.definitionFit: To beware of something is to be on guard against it.

clue.text: A high-flier — sounds secure in the job

indicators.note: sounds tells us the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to earn is to gain by working

explanation.surface: An ambitious person who sounds safe in their employment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high-flier' suggests a go-getter, but it is a bird, the sea eagle.
explanation.definitionFit: The erne, or sea eagle, is a bird that soars high.

clue.text: Tottered as a result of wound

definitions.meaning: wound onto a reel, as fishing line

explanation.surface: Staggering after being injured.
explanation.definitionFit: Reeled means both staggered and wound onto a spool.

clue.text: Given credit, scoff — no-one backs the concept

parts.note: to scoff is to eat greedily

indicators.note: backs means the letters for no one are read in reverse

parts.note: no plus one, the numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone credited with mocking an idea that nobody supports.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no-one' splits into NO and I (one); 'backs' reverses them to ION.
explanation.definitionFit: A creation is something devised or conceived, an invention or idea.

clue.text: It's shaped like a sword in the gardens at Ely

indicators.note: in tells us the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A plant with sword-shaped leaves in a cathedral city's gardens.
explanation.walkthrough: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Ensate is a botanical term meaning sword-shaped, from Latin ensis, sword.

clue.text: Intelligence shown

parts.note: intelligence suggests cleverness, but means information, here screened in a cinema

explanation.definitionFit: A short film of current events, as once screened in cinemas.
